# llmadk live gate: 2026-09-26

`make integration` (go test -tags=integration ./...) against the live provider
APIs with LLMADK_RECORD=1, ADK v2.4.0, genai v1.70.0. Runs on this date, in
order: the full gate at root bceef4e (every row but those below); the
claude-sonnet-5 tool_loop row at root 6f6c687 (after the default-model and
empty-thinking fixes); the two fallback rows at root 6f6c687. Fixtures under
testdata/fixtures were recorded by those runs; TestFixtures replays them
offline. Replay serves recorded responses in order and does not compare request bodies
(minted tool-call IDs differ per run); it checks every request against its
family's wire rules (wire_test.go), and request translation is also covered by
the unit and end-to-end tests.

| Scenario | Families (models) | Result |
|---|---|---|
| tool_loop | openai-chat (gpt-5.4-mini), openai-responses (gpt-5.4-mini), anthropic (claude-haiku-4-5), gemini (gemini-3.5-flash-lite), openrouter (openai/gpt-5.4-mini) | pass |
| tool_loop_stream | same five | pass |
| tool_loop | anthropic-sonnet-5 (claude-sonnet-5, the new Anthropic default) | pass |
| thinking_tools | openai-responses (encrypted reasoning replay), anthropic (manual thinking, signature replay, alias model name), gemini (thought signatures) | pass |
| structured_tools | openai-chat, anthropic, gemini | pass |
| switch_into_claude | openai-chat then claude-haiku-4-5, manual thinking | pass; thinking suspended (anthropic.thinking_suspended) |
| switch_into_claude_adaptive | openai-responses then claude-sonnet-4-6, adaptive thinking | pass; no suspension, Anthropic accepts the foreign turn |
| switch_into_claude_always_on | openai-responses then claude-fable-5-1 | pass; no suspension |
| switch_into_gemini3 | openai-chat then gemini-3.5-flash-lite | pass; foreign call carries Google's placeholder |
| envelope reaches ADK's native Gemini | our gemini, then ADK gemini.NewModel | pass |
| envelope reaches ADK's native Gemini | our anthropic, then ADK gemini.NewModel | pass |
| fallback_into_claude | FallbackChain: openai-responses fails after step 1, claude-haiku-4-5 with manual thinking serves the rest | pass; thinking suspended |
| fallback_into_openai | FallbackChain: claude-haiku-4-5 with thinking fails after step 1, openai-responses serves the rest | pass |

Found by this gate and fixed before it passed:

- The root Gemini provider sent tool schemas in Gemini's OpenAPI-subset
  `parameters` field, which rejects `additionalProperties` (present in every
  schema ADK generates from a Go struct). Fixed in the root: tool and response
  schemas now go in `parametersJsonSchema` and `responseJsonSchema`.
- ADK's native Gemini model rejected the bridge's reasoning envelopes in
  ThoughtSignature ("Corrupted thought signature") and then another provider's
  function calls without a signature. Gemini's own signatures are now stored
  as the raw bytes Gemini issued, other providers' envelopes moved to
  PartMetadata, and the first call of a response without a Gemini signature
  carries Google's skip_thought_signature_validator placeholder.

- The Anthropic and Gemini default models (claude-sonnet-4-20250514,
  gemini-2.5-flash) were retired; the example program failed on them. Defaults
  are now claude-sonnet-5 and gemini-3.5-flash.
- Claude Sonnet 5 returns a thinking block with an empty text, which the
  Anthropic provider replayed without its required "thinking" field; fixed in
  the root.

Not covered live:

- Mistral, Groq, Cerebras, DeepSeek and Perplexity (no API keys).
- ADK's Gemini model on Vertex AI, which refuses PartMetadata client-side
  (documented), and Vertex-issued Gemini signatures replayed on the Gemini API.
- Gemini 2.5 with parametersJsonSchema/responseJsonSchema: 2.5 models are not
  available to this account's key ("no longer available to new users"), so the
  schema-field fix is verified on Gemini 3.5 only.
- Z.AI web search (above). The bridge now asks for results
  (IncludeResults) so they can become grounding metadata; that mapping is
  unit-tested only.
